147-4454-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-4454-5231.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2063-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
2063-6034-8089.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-5131-6798-7753--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6798-7753--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

3043-4067-7890.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
3043-4067-7890.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

2073-5315-6808-7878.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is 12 or less.
2073-5315-6808-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning The Last Ride from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Last Ride enters, Kolodin triggers, causing The Last Ride to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing The Last Ride.
When The Last Ride dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2919-5086-5183-5231-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-5086-5183-5231-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

1545-4399-4518-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-4399-4518-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

443-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2946-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1982-6972.description:
Cast Sidisi by paying its mana cost.
When Sidisi enters, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Sidisi dies, its persist ability and second innate ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, searching your library for a card and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat from step 2

4499-6723-7292-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

3165-3532-5078-7650.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-7506.easyPrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7506.description:
Cast Replicate by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-7506.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2018-2438-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
2018-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

460-539-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Sage of the Maze.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

394-856-5776-6797.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2615-4785-6562.description:
Cast Tree of Perdition by paying {3}{B}.
When Tree of Perdition enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers, targeting an opponent.
If the opponent has 13 or more life, hold priority and then activate Tree of Perdition by tapping it, swapping its toughness with an opponent's life total.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing the opponent targeted in step 3 to lose life equal to Tree of Perdition's toughness.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 or less life.
2615-4785-6562.notes: Regardless of the opponent's life total, they will go down to 0 or less life and lose the game. If their life total is 12 or less, they lose 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger and lose. If they have 13 or more life, their life total becomes 13 and they will lose at least 13 life from the Jaws of Defeat trigger.

3054-4050-6248.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6248.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2178-3362-5147-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-5147-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1939-3490-4659-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1939-3490-4659-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom indestructible.
1939-3490-4659-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

11-3258-5257.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Beacon of Tomorrows.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Beacon of Tomorrows, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Beacon of Tomorrows and returning the original Beacon of Tomorrows to your hand.
Resolve Beacon of Tomorrows, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-3258-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

230-2252-3129-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
230-2252-3129-4050.description:
Activate Necrogenesis by paying {2}, exling a creature card from an opponent's graveyard and creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card from an opponent's exile into their graveyard, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scions, adding {2}.
Repeat.

1444-3152-4445.notablePrerequisites: Leyline Immersion attached to a legendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
1444-3152-4445.description:
Activate the creature with Leyline Immersion attached by tapping it, adding {4}{G} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Elvish Fury with buyback by paying {4}{G}, targeting Chakram Retriever.
Chakram Retriever triggers, causing you to untap the creature with Leyline Immersion attached.
Resolve Elvish Fury, giving Chakram Retriever +2/+2 until end of turn and returning Elvish Fury to your hand.
Repeat.

2634-4276-4910.notablePrerequisites: All other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
2634-4276-4910.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control except Alchemist's Refuge by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Alchemist's Refuge's second ability by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

2488-4884.notablePrerequisites:
Darksteel Plate attached to Apex Altisaur.
You have a way to deal damage to Apex Altisaur.
2488-4884.description:
Deal damage to Apex Altisaur, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Apex Altisaur is dealt damage by the creature, triggering its enrage ability, causing it to fight an opponent's creature with power one or greater.
Repeat step 2.

2-1636.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {5}.
2-1636.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

522-4551.description:
Phyrexian Unlife prevents you from losing the game due to having zero or less life, and causes all damage that would be done to you while you have zero or less life to be infect damage.
Melira prevents you from getting poison counters, thus negating the infect damage.

132-2364-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use any other ability from Staff of Domination in step 1 instead.

413-1283-2608.description:
Tap Chromatic Orrery for 5 {C}.
Activate Derevi to put it into play and untap Chromatic Orrery with its enter the battlefield trigger.
Untap Blasting Station.
Sacrifice Derevi to Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1518-1987-3277-3941.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3277-3941.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
